'''Odrell Vorbaal''' was a [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who owned [[Slag Pit/Legends|The Slag Pit]], a gambling den located on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. He was also a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] dealer backed by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. He primarily sold [[Glitterstim/Legends|gliterstim]].<ref name="LoNH" />
